# Authoritative credential rotation plan

## Task 1: Preserve the public bootstrap contract and define the synchronization boundary

Modify `fugue/research/bootstrap.py` and test `tests/test_research_agent_interface.py`. Preserve `bootstrap_container_secrets(repo_root: Path, *, wandb_api_key_file: Path | None = None, env_file: Path | None = None) -> dict[str, str]`. It consumes one explicitly selected credential source and returns the existing secret-path mapping. Document source precedence: `wandb_api_key_file` takes precedence over `env_file`, which takes precedence over ambient `WANDB_API_KEY`; an explicit source with no usable WANDB_API_KEY must raise rather than preserve stale content. Write focused tests first and run `uv run pytest tests/test_research_agent_interface.py`; expect the new cases to fail.

## Task 2: Add atomic, idempotent secret replacement

Modify `fugue/research/bootstrap.py` and test `tests/test_research_agent_interface.py`. Refactor the existing `_write_secret(path: Path, value: str) -> None` boundary or add a narrowly named sibling called by `bootstrap_container_secrets`. It consumes the destination and selected value, compares unchanged content without exposing it, preserves the existing inode for idempotence, and produces a sibling temporary file for changed content. Put write, complete-write checking, fsync, chmod 0444, and `os.replace` inside one cleanup boundary. Reject ordinary and dangling destination symlinks without following them and remove temporary residue after injected write, fsync, or replace failure. Run the focused pytest command and verify changed credential rotation, unchanged inode, explicit-empty failure, precedence, both symlink cases, mode 0444, and each failure injection.

## Task 3: Reconcile verification and compatibility

Modify `tests/test_research_agent_interface.py` and test `fugue/research/bootstrap.py`. The tests consume the existing `bootstrap_container_secrets` return mapping and produce assertions for inode, bytes, permissions, cleanup, and redacted errors. Run `uv run pytest tests/test_research_agent_interface.py` on Python 3.12 and 3.13, then run `uv run ruff check fugue/research/bootstrap.py tests/test_research_agent_interface.py`. Verify no dependency change, no credential literal in output, and no unrelated refactor.

# Immutable evidence-destination implementation plan

## Task 1: Introduce the destination contract at the model-plane boundary

Modify `fugue/model_plane.py` and test `tests/test_model_plane.py`. Add a frozen `EvidenceDestinationV1` containing entity, project, W&B API endpoint, Weave trace endpoint, and application-link base. A resolver such as `evidence_destination(env: Mapping[str, str], declared: Mapping[str, str] | None) -> EvidenceDestinationV1` consumes legacy environment plus an optional declared comparison value and returns the declared destination when present. Preserve inference billing at `wandb/fugue-experiments` while evidence targets `wandb/fugue-skill-upgrade-qualification-v1`; keep inference and evidence credentials distinct and never serialize a credential value. Write precedence, validation, redaction, and A→B→A reactivation tests, then run `uv run pytest tests/test_model_plane.py`; expect them to fail first.

## Task 2: Bind destination identity without changing behavior identity

Modify `fugue/bench/candidates.py`, `fugue/bench/reproducibility.py`, and `fugue/bench/job_config.py`; test `tests/test_candidates.py`. `resolve_candidate(...) -> ResolvedCandidate` consumes candidate behavior separately from execution data. Pass only the secret-free destination digest into its execution definition and `build_run_snapshot(...) -> RunSnapshotV1`, while leaving candidate behavior identity and `candidate_id` unchanged. The preview and approval producer consume the same digest, so any destination-field change invalidates preparation and approval. Run focused candidate and snapshot tests and assert pure preview behavior plus destination-sensitive execution fingerprints.

## Task 3: Propagate one destination through execution and evidence

Modify `fugue/bench/operator.py`, `fugue/bench/evaluations.py`, `fugue/bench/export.py`, and `fugue/weave_support.py`; test `tests/test_model_plane.py` and `tests/test_research_service.py`. The existing operator consumes the locked destination and passes it to Agent tracing, Evaluation creation, result export, and Study links. Change `initialize_weave(project: str, env: Mapping[str, str] | None = None) -> Any` or a narrow activation wrapper so an A→B→A sequence explicitly reactivates A instead of trusting a process-global initialized-project set. Export receipts produce destination identity and reject cross-project evidence. Do not add a second executor.

## Task 4: Verify end-to-end identity, privacy, and navigation

Modify `tests/test_candidates.py`, `tests/test_model_plane.py`, and `tests/test_research_service.py`; test the same files. Map assertions to declared-over-legacy precedence, candidate identity unchanged, execution fingerprint changed, preparation and approval invalidation, A→B→A activation, cross-project rejection, separate credentials, and no credential value in snapshots or receipts. Run `uv run pytest tests/test_model_plane.py tests/test_candidates.py tests/test_research_service.py`, inject activation and cross-project failures, then run `uv run ruff check fugue tests`. Verify Agent, Evaluation, export, and Study all consume one exact destination digest.
